directive.name: github
directive.description: Full GitHub team workflow. Owns ALL git and GitHub operations. Issues for tracking, draft PRs at plan, WIP pushes, review-gated merges. Task artifacts (.festinalente/tasks/, .festinalente/quick/) are gitignored — never committed. Spec and plan content is posted to GitHub Issues for team visibility. Requires GitHub MCP server.

context.principle: Branch names: {type}/{id} where type is derived from task label's commit-type in workflow.yaml (feature→feat, bug→fix, refactor→refactor, docs→docs, default: feat). Quick tasks use quick/{id}.

Conventional commits: type(#{issueNumber}): description. Scope is the GitHub issue number (e.g., #26), not the task slug. The issue is always created before the first commit so the number is available.
All merges through GitHub PRs via squash merge. Never merge locally to main. The PR title (conventional commit format) becomes the single commit on main.
Every task syncs to a GitHub Issue for team visibility.
Every save pushes. Draft PR reflects WIP automatically.
PR body includes "Closes #N" to auto-close the linked issue.
Draft PR at plan phase. User marks ready on GitHub at finalize.
Task artifacts are gitignored — never committed, pushed, or deleted by git.

MCP tools (all lowercase): mcp__github__{create,get,update}_issue, mcp__github__add_issue_comment, mcp__github__{create,get}_pull_request, mcp__github__get_pull_request_{status,comments,reviews}, mcp__github__merge_pull_request. No update_pull_request tool exists. Use update_issue for PR title/body (PRs are issues in GitHub's API). Draft status must be changed manually on GitHub.

process.rule: 1. Verify on main. If not, error and exit. 2. Derive branch type from task label's commit-type in workflow.yaml. Default: feat. 3. Create GitHub Issue FIRST (so #{issueNumber} is available for commits): IF $ARGUMENTS is an issue number (#N): Fetch via mcp__github__get_issue. ELSE: Create via mcp__github__create_issue (title, body, labels, assignees). Add github-issue="#N" and github-url to task.xml. 4. Create branch and push: git checkout -b {type}/{id} Add github-branch="{type}/{id}" to task.xml. git push -u origin {type}/{id}

1. VERIFY BRANCH. 2. Comment on GitHub Issue with spec: mcp__github__add_issue_comment — "## Scoped

```xml
{spec.xml}
```"
VERIFY BRANCH. Do NOT commit — code stays uncommitted until save or finalize.
1. VERIFY BRANCH. 2. Check for changes: git status && git diff --name-only. If none, warn and exit. 3. git add {changed code files} git commit -m "wip(#{issueNumber}): {progress summary}" git push

1. VERIFY BRANCH. 2. Check for uncommitted changes. Display files. If none, ask whether to proceed. 3. Determine commit type from task label via workflow.yaml. Default: feat. 4. Commit implementation: git add {changed code files} git commit -m "{type}(#{issueNumber}): {title}" 5. If directive check failed and auto-fixed: git add {files} && git commit -m "fix(#{issueNumber}): check-retry - {title}" Restart all checks. 6. If docs were updated: git add .festinalente/product/ .festinalente/engineering/ .festinalente/glossary.yaml git commit -m "docs(#{issueNumber}): {product|engineering|product+engineering} - {summary}" 7. git push

Read github-pr from task.xml:
NO github-pr (plan was skipped): Create PR via mcp__github__create_pull_request (not draft). Title: "{type}(#{issueNumber}): {title}". Body: "Closes #{issueNumber}

## Summary
{brief description}". Add github-pr to task.xml. Continue below.
HAS github-pr — check via mcp__github__get_pull_request: state="merged" → Go to GH-FIN-CLEANUP. state="closed" → Prompt "PR closed. Create new?" then create. mergeable=false → git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease. Re-check PR state.
Update PR via mcp__github__update_issue: title: "{type}(#{issueNumber}): {title}" body: "Closes #{issueNumber}

## Summary
{brief description}"
Check via mcp__github__get_pull_request_status: draft=true → "PR updated. Mark ready on GitHub, re-run finalize after approval." EXIT. reviewDecision="CHANGES_REQUESTED" → "Address PR feedback first." EXIT. reviewDecision="APPROVED" or (null AND mergeable_state="clean") → Go to GH-FIN-MERGE. else → "Awaiting review or checks." EXIT.

1. Prompt: "PR #{N} approved. Merge now or wait?" 2. If merge: a. Update task status="done", add completed date (local only). b. mcp__github__merge_pull_request (merge_method: "squash"). c. git checkout main && git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/main d. git branch -D {github-branch} e. Output: "Merged! Issue #{issueNumber} auto-closed." 3. If wait: EXIT.

PR already merged externally: 1. git checkout main && git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/main 2. git branch -D {github-branch} 3. Update task status="done", add completed date (local only). 4. Output: "PR was already merged. Local branch cleaned up."

1. VERIFY BRANCH. 2. If github-pr exists: a. Gather unresolved PR feedback: mcp__github__get_pull_request_reviews — review decisions and body text. mcp__github__get_pull_request_comments — inline and conversation comments. Filter to unresolved/actionable items. b. Present feedback to user as context for rework issue report. Pre-populate from PR comments where possible. c. After rework report is created, comment on PR: mcp__github__add_issue_comment — "## Rework\n\n{issue summary and planned actions}" d. Output: "If the PR is marked ready, convert it back to draft on GitHub."

1. Read task.xml for github-pr, github-issue, github-branch. 2. If not on main: git checkout main. 3. GitHub cleanup: If github-pr: close via mcp__github__update_issue (state: "closed") + comment "Task deleted." via mcp__github__add_issue_comment. If github-issue: close via mcp__github__update_issue (state: "closed"). If remote branch exists: git push origin --delete {github-branch} If local branch exists: git branch -D {github-branch} 4. Delete local task files: rm -rf .festinalente/tasks/{id}/
Verify on main. git add .festinalente/product/ && git commit -m "docs: define-product - {description}" && git push
Verify on main. git add .festinalente/product/ .festinalente/glossary.yaml && git commit -m "docs: map-product - {summary}" && git push
Verify on main. git add .festinalente/engineering/ .festinalente/glossary.yaml && git commit -m "docs: map-engineering - {summary}" && git push
Verify on main. git add .festinalente/directives/{name}.xml .festinalente/config.yaml && git commit -m "docs: create directive - {name}" && git push

check.item: GitHub MCP server is connected (mcp__github__* tools available)
Repository has remote origin with push access
Commits use conventional format: type(#issueNumber): description
No task artifacts staged or committed
GitHub issue linked (github-issue attribute on task/quick xml)

example.code: # task.xml (local only, gitignored): <task id="022-add-dark-mode" status="backlog" github-issue="#42" github-branch="feat/022-add-dark-mode" github-pr="#43">
# Commits on feat/022-add-dark-mode (no artifact commits): wip(#42): add toggle component and theme provider feat(#42): add dark mode toggle docs(#42): product+engineering - dark mode docs

# WRONG: committing task artifacts git add .festinalente/tasks/022/task.xml # WRONG: task slug as scope feat(022-add-dark-mode): Add dark mode toggle # WRONG: local merge git checkout main && git merge feat/022-add-dark-mode --no-ff
# CORRECT: artifacts gitignored, issue number scope, merge via MCP feat(#42): Add dark mode toggle mcp__github__merge_pull_request
